selection_reason: IRI_mean_y is selected as the continuous regression target because IRI is a standard pavement ride-quality and condition metric, and the _y suffix suggests the outcome-side or later/post-treatment condition variable in this joined dataset.

selected_candidate_record.leakage_guard: Potential condition metric. Downstream agents must prevent leakage by excluding any post-period / outcome / future condition columns from features if applicable.

competing_candidates_not_selected.not_selected_reason: Not selected because _x suggests baseline/input-side IRI. It may be conditionally allowed as a prior-condition feature if measured before IRI_mean_y.
Not selected because cracking is an important distress measure but this _x candidate is better treated as a baseline/input feature for predicting future ride quality.
Not selected because rutting is an important distress measure but this _x candidate is better treated as a baseline/input feature.

hard_ban_patterns: *_y except selected target removed from X

IRI_mean_x.condition: May be used only if interpreted as baseline/current/pre-treatment IRI measured before IRI_mean_y.
fallback_if_temporal_provenance_unclear: Run full baseline model with IRI_mean_x
Run strict no-prior-IRI model excluding IRI_mean_x

Future_AADT_mean_x.note: Contains the word Future but appears to be a traffic forecast variable, not necessarily pavement condition leakage.

target_handling.missing_target_rows: drop from supervised modeling; do not impute target
